info.title: Junction Pay Admin API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/

page-cursor.name: page[cursor]
page-cursor.description: Pagination cursor that defines your place in the list.

page-limit.name: page[limit]
page-limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

ConversionInclude.name: include
ConversionInclude.description: Customize which related resources to return

MoneyAmount.title: Money amount
MoneyAmount.description: A positive integer representing an amount of currency defined in the currency's smallest unit. This means that for currencies that have minor units, like EUR, 1 euro would be represented as 100, indicating 100 cents.

externalReference.description: The UUID related to a specific transaction in our integrating partners DB

beneficiary.description: This is how much Junction PAY will need to pay out

quotation.description: The amount that Junction PAY will be owed

baseConverted.description: The amount Junction PAY will need to collect in the payers currency to cover what Junction PAY owes to a beneficiary

salesMargin.description: The monetary value of the sales markup for a specific transaction

fxMargin.description: The monetary value of the fx markup for a specific transaction for Junction PAY

fxProviderMargin.description: The monetary value of the provider markup for a specific transaction

fxQuote.description: The FX rate Junction PAY provided during the quotation call

fxBuffer.description: The amount  the exchange rate can move between quotation and transaction before Junction PAY loose money on the trade

salesMarkup.description: The percentage Junction PAY adds as a sales fee

fxMarkup.description: The percentage Junction PAY adds to foreign exchange

conversion.description: The ID that links and FX transaction in the provider system to Junction PAYs transcation history

payer.description: The ID used to determine who will owe Junction PAY a monetary value

beneficiary.description: The ID used to determine who Junction PAY owes a monetary value to

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like `title``, this field’s value can be localized.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

source.description: An object containing references to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

parameter.description: A string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

header.description: A string indicating the name of a single request header which caused the error.
